story_theme_en: A bridge is 150 meters long with railings on both sides, each 150 meters long. The two railings are parallel. If the distance between the two railings is 4 meters, how wide is the bridge? If you paint both railings with 2 coats, how many square meters of railing need painting per side?
helper_tip: Area of railing = Length × Width. For both sides, total area = 2 × Length × Width.
hint_th: พื้นที่ราว = ความยาว × ความกว้าง

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Bridge width = left railing 4 m + gap 4 m + right railing 4 m = 12 m | Area per side railing = 150 × 0.5 = 75 sq m | For 2 coats = 75 × 2 = 150 sq m per side

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A bridge railing is 80 meters long and 0.6 meters wide. Painting 3 coats. How many square meters to paint?
visual_blocks.explanation: Area = 80 × 0.6 = 48 sq m | 3 coats = 48 × 3 = 144 sq m
